categories.main_business_segments: InventisBio Co., Limited is an innovative drug R&D company based in China with a global perspective, focusing on major diseases including oncology, metabolic diseases, and autoimmune diseases. The company develops proprietary innovative drugs with independent intellectual property rights, primarily small molecule targeted therapies. Its product pipeline includes one marketed product under license and multiple clinical and preclinical stage candidates.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced drug discovery technologies including precise target screening, computer-aided drug design, pharmacology and translational medicine, chemical synthesis and formulation development, and clinical trial design. It has established platforms for high-throughput screening, pharmacokinetics, early toxicology, and clinical development. Manufacturing is outsourced to third-party CDMOs for clinical trial materials, with strict quality control and regulatory compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are pharmaceutical companies and healthcare providers involved in oncology, metabolic, and autoimmune disease treatment. The company collaborates with leading domestic and international pharmaceutical firms such as Betta Pharmaceuticals, CSPC, Pfizer, and Merck for development and commercialization. The end markets include China and international regions including the US, Australia, South Korea, and Taiwan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with R&D centers also in Beijing, Shanghai, and the United States. Clinical trials and product registrations are conducted in China, the US, Australia, South Korea, and Taiwan. Commercialization partnerships cover mainland China, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, with plans to expand internationally through licensing and collaborations.
categories.supply_chain_position: InventisBio operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug discovery, development, clinical trials, and regulatory approval. It outsources manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients and formulations to contract manufacturers (CDMOs). Commercial production and sales are conducted by partners or planned to be done via self-built sales teams in the future.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on developing innovative drugs addressing unmet clinical needs in oncology, metabolic, and autoimmune diseases. It emphasizes proprietary drug discovery with global intellectual property rights, accelerating clinical development, and expanding product pipelines. R&D priorities include advancing clinical-stage candidates, enriching preclinical projects, upgrading R&D infrastructure, and building a global clinical development network.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through technology licensing and collaboration agreements, including upfront payments, milestone payments, and royalties from partnered commercialization. Currently, the company has one licensed marketed product generating milestone and royalty income. It has not yet commercialized products independently but plans to develop self-sales capabilities in China and continue licensing internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the innovative pharmaceutical R&D sector with a focus on targeted therapies for cancer and metabolic diseases. Competitors include multinational pharmaceutical companies and other innovative biotech firms with stronger financial resources and commercialization experience. InventisBio positions itself as a leading Chinese innovative drug developer with a global clinical development footprint and proprietary technology platforms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, InventisBio reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 185.5 million, primarily from technology licensing, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 283.98 million, showing a reduced loss compared to prior years. The company maintains high R&D investment (over RMB 442 million in 2023) and has total assets of about RMB 2.16 billion. It is in a growth phase with expanding clinical pipelines and increasing licensing income.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: InventisBio emphasizes its proprietary innovative drug candidates with independent intellectual property rights, targeting high unmet medical needs in major disease areas. Its competitive advantages include a one-stop integrated R&D platform, high R&D efficiency, advanced drug design technologies, and a global clinical trial network. The company’s products demonstrate superior safety, efficacy, and convenience (e.g., oral SERD vs. injectable competitors), aiming to provide safer, more effective, and affordable therapies globally.
